subject: Integration accelerator: proposed priority matrix & asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <partner@nimbuscloud.com>, Jamie Park <solutions@elara.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Integration accelerator: proposed priority matrix & asks

Alex / Jamie —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I promised a short follow-up with the initial priority matrix for the ISV+SI integration work so engineering can size and we can align on a delivery window. Attached is a one-sheet (integration_priority_matrix.xlsx) that groups asks into: core API contracts, authentication/entitlement, sandbox/testing, and billing/metering.

Quick asks we need answers to by next week (EOW 7/7):
- Confirm supported auth: do you expect SAML SSO or OAuth2 client credentials for service-to-service comms?
- Are there per-tenant entitlement checks needed (per-customer plan flags), or will entitlement be handled via the marketplace license payload?
- Sandbox access: request a test tenant + service account that supports a 60k token monthly limit for performance runs.
- Billing hooks: we need a sample invoice event payload and an expected cadence for usage reports.

Lauren / Tessa, tagging you for prioritization and rollout plan inputs. Proposed high-level timeline in the sheet: discovery (2w), integration sprint (3w), canary (2w), GA.

I'll schedule a short follow-up next Tue for any open questions.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Sr. Partner PM, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachment: integration_priority_matrix.xlsx
From: Alex Chen <partner@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <solutions@elara.io>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration accelerator: proposed priority matrix & asks

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary and the matrix. Quick answers inline:
- Auth: Our platform supports OAuth2 client credentials for server-to-server by default; SAML is used for end-user SSO. For the marketplace flow we typically rely on the marketplace license payload + OAuth2 token exchange. If Redwood needs SAML for admin flows we can add it but expect an extra week for config.
- Entitlements: Nimbus prefers entitlement flags passed in the license payload; however our SI partners sometimes require an additional entitlement call back to our entitlement API. We can support either.
- Sandbox: I can provision a test tenant but need your list of sample org IDs and the desired token quotas.
- Billing: We push daily usage reports (JSON) and a monthly invoice event. I'll attach our billing spec after I get confirmation from finance.

I'll loop Jamie from our integrator partner Elara — they run the SI implementation and will want to sync on API contract specifics.

Propose a technical kickoff next Thu 7/8 10am PT if that works.

Best,
Alex Chen
Partnerships Lead, Nimbus Cloud
partner@nimbuscloud.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <partner@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration accelerator: proposed priority matrix & asks

All —

Thanks Alex. A couple of product clarifications from our side after reviewing the matrix:
- For entitlements, Redwood would prefer the license payload approach if it contains: plan_id, feature_flags, and seat_count. If Nimbus can guarantee that payload on purchase events, we can avoid a separate entitlement API call and reduce latency.
- Metering: we need a well-defined per-token and per-call attribution for marketplace-tracked usage. Can Nimbus include resource identifiers in the daily usage report so our billing reconciliation can map consumption to customer accounts?
- Versioning: please indicate whether the API will follow semantic versioning (v1, v2) and the deprecation window for breaking changes. We need >= 60 days notice for breaking changes.

I updated the drive doc with a short product note and a suggested classification for priority (P0–P2). Link: https://drive.google.com/redwood/integration-accelerator/priority-matrix

If Nimbus can confirm the license payload fields and the billing resource IDs by EOD Mon 7/5 we can lock the discovery sprint start for 7/6.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Director, Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <partner@nimbuscloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration accelerator: proposed priority matrix & asks

Alex / team —

Appreciate the quick responses. Operational asks from infra/ops perspective:
- Sandbox creds: please provide a service account key (CSV) scoped to the test tenant and a short-lived admin token for load runs. We will only use the account for performance and end-to-end validation in our staging cluster.
- Canary plan: Redwood intends to run a 2-week canary on a 5% traffic slice then expand. We need Nimbus to support a fallback route in case of failure (routing to Redwood-hosted fallback model).
- Observability hooks: will Nimbus expose request/response IDs in their logs so we can correlate traces? If not, we need a correlation header we can pass through.

I attached a pared-down integration spec (integration_spec_v1.pdf) with the headers and healthcheck endpoints we expect.

If we can get sandbox access by 7/6 morning, engineering can start validation and we keep the 7/6 discovery date.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Partnerships PM, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Attachment: integration_spec_v1.pdf
From: Alex Chen <partner@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Park <solutions@elara.io>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration accelerator: proposed priority matrix & asks

Tessa / Ben / Lauren —

Good news: sandbox tenant created and creds attached (sandbox_credentials.csv). The tenant includes a service account with 80k token monthly quota and an admin token valid for 7 days. Billing and usage team are generating the sample usage report schema (will send by EOD Fri).

We can confirm license payload will include plan_id, feature_flags, seat_count, and resource_id for metering. API will be semver'd; we provide a 90-day deprecation window for breaking changes.

Technical kickoff confirmed for Thu 7/8 10am PT — invite sent to this thread. Jamie from Elara will lead the SI integration plan.

Next steps:
- Redwood to validate sandbox and run smoke tests (target 7/6–7/7)
- Nimbus to deliver usage schema (EOD 7/2)
- Kickoff 7/8 10am PT

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Alex
Alex Chen | Partnerships Lead, Nimbus Cloud
partner@nimbuscloud.com
Attachment: sandbox_credentials.csv
